title: Design Memory Allocator
summary: Design a memory allocator over n units: allocate reserves the leftmost run of size consecutive free units for an id and returns its first index or -1; freeMemory releases all units with an id, even across several blocks, and returns how many were freed.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n, size, mID <= 1000; at most 1000 calls to allocate and freeMemory (from the recovered statement).
visualizationNotes: Operation sequence, not a single input; the full example call list was not retrieved in full.
inputFormat: Constructor takes n; allocate takes size and mID; freeMemory takes mID.
outputFormat: allocate returns the first index or -1; freeMemory returns the count of freed units.
edgeRules: freeMemory of an unused id returns 0.
nextAction: Official page confirmation pending. Recovered statement is complete for the requirements; examples are not copied to the website.
